text.tspan: """Full-stack developer from Berlin. I build web apps and ship them."""
# a new one every few seconds

g.text: Ship something useful → learn → ship again.
// Code should be useful before it's clever
// Boring architecture is usually the right one
// Tests are letters from past me to future me
// A good name is half the documentation
// Make it work, make it right, make it fast
// First, do no harm to production
// The best code is code you don't have to write
// Read the code, not the comments
// I write Python the way I'd explain it to a friend
// Build it once for yourself, then share it
// Every commit is a small gift to my future team
